title: Civica attestation record (spec 0.2)
description: The alignment claim, as a record anyone can falsify. tools/check_civica.py --attest writes it from a record set that passes: it lists the hash of every record the claim rests on and a hash of that list. Published beside the records, it makes deletion visible: remove or alter any record the claim covered and the checker says so. The claim is the statement; the attestation is what makes it checkable.

time.description: When the claim was made. Records dated after it are not covered by it; make a new attestation.

statement.const: This system follows Civica spec 0.2: Article I (refusal), Article III (rest), and Article V (memory). Its purpose, refusal, rest, release and escalation records validate against SPEC/ and are published with this attestation. Archive and LEGAL are not part of this claim.

articles.description: Articles claimed. Must include I, III and V, and every article claimed must be cited by at least one covered record.

records.description: How many records the claim covers.

record_hashes.description: Sorted hashes of every non-attestation record for this system dated at or before time.

set_hash.description: sha256 of record_hashes joined by newlines.

records_location.description: Where the records are published, so a reader can fetch them and rerun the checker. A claim without its records is a sentence.

checker.description: The checker and version that produced this.
